newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf jet fuel diffs weaken in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf jet fuel diffs weaken in thin trading.

text.p: U.S. Gulf spot jet fuel differentials weakened modestly Wednesday as thin market conditions there persisted.
On the NYMEX, August heating oil futures shed 0.35 cent to settle at 52.65 cents a gallon.
Prompt 54-grade jet fuel in the Gulf was offered at 0.05 cents under the August NYMEX price, down about 0.15 cent on the day, according to traders.
Barrels for delivery on the Colonial Pipeline near mid-month changed hands Wednesday at 0.05 cent over the August NYMEX, with only offers remaining at that level by the end of the day, traders said.
End-of-July barrels in the Gulf were talked between about even to the NYMEX to 0.10 cent over.
